reason: You want EUR 5,000 out of me for three months and you can't tell me what a meeting costs or when it pays back, only that nothing is guaranteed. I'm entering a new country next year, so maybe then, but not on a promise of 'usually 30-60 days'.
objection: We could just buy Apollo and have one of our sales people do it for a fraction of EUR 1,500 a month. I don't see what I get that justifies the gap, and with no meeting target I carry all the risk.
would_change_my_mind: A cost per qualified meeting from real clients in wholesale, ideally in the country we're entering, plus part of the fee tied to meetings delivered or a way out after month one if there are none.
